text: ねえ　いつも　かっこいい　シューズ　はいてるわね！

structure.jp: いつも　かっこいい　シューズ　はいてるわね！
structure.en: you're always wearing cool shoes, aren't you!

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says something is going on or is the present state; てる is the casual short form. はいてる = 'are wearing'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end of a sentence gives a soft, feminine tone, and ね adds 'aren't you'. はいてるわね = 'you're wearing them, aren't you'.
